title: Moove - Plan Itinerary (Light Mode)
creator: Agensip - Startup MVP Design Partner
observed: Viewed 800px source image. White mobile sheets, restrained orange active tab and primary button, day-based itinerary rows, small destination images, action-sheet treatment. Fine body copy is intentionally not interpreted as product requirements.
adaptation: Keep a single useful orange action and a plain, readable day timeline; replace their dashboard density with editorial discovery and warm paper.
asset_rights: Reference only; upstream image and kit are not included in the deliverable.
